early.name: Monster Rounds
early.annotation: You need NPC damage early game for your Turrent and Weapon.

early.name: Suppressor
early.annotation: Since you will be unlocking at least 4 turrets during your laning phase only, Suppressor on your turrets will be super annoying for the enemy. Especially for High Fire Rate heroes.

early.name: Enchanter's Emblem
early.annotation: Since you have healing. Staying above 65% health shouldn't be a problem early game. Just don't be too aggressive and you should have free damage and CD reduction for your turrets.

mid.name: Heroic Aura
mid.annotation: Dractically increases your Turret DPS. Insane damage. But if are having trouble escaping from fights. Get Stamina Mastery before this.

mid.name: Rapid Recharge
mid.annotation: You unlock a total of 5 turrets and on top of that they get more CD reduction.

mid.name: Escalating Exposure
mid.annotation: This is the point where your turrets really start feeling powerful. Since you will be spawning multiple turrets, the chance of getting max stacks of EE on enemies increases drastically.

late.name: Greater Expansion
late.annotation: Greatly increases Range on your Turrets and your Ult.

late.name: Indomitable
late.annotation: Mainly for Rem's Ult, Lash's Ult, Bebop hook, Mina's Ult, Paradox's Ult, Mo & Krill's Ult, Paige's Ult. Basically any ult that stuns you.

late.name: Boundless Spirit
late.annotation: I reach 75-80k player damage easily without this mod. Get this if you have to for your ult damage but not really necessary.

late.name: Spirit Burn
late.annotation: Peak item for your turrets. Once you have at least 2 turrets spawned on the field, just activate Heroic Aura, and you procc Spirit Burn is less than 2 seconds. Forces your opponents into panic mode.

late.name: Transcendent Cooldown
late.annotation: Final form. 13.5s CD for your turret charges and 3s delay between each charge usage. If you buy Rapid Recharge your CD becomes 11.6s with 2.1s delay between each charge usage.
